title: Machine learning-based screening of asthma biomarkers and related immune infiltration
summary: Full Frontiers article reports ML screening of asthma transcriptomic biomarkers. Eight genes were selected; external performance varies, so this is a computational biomarker result, not causal biology. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: The Second Affiliated Hospital and Yuying Children's Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University; Jinhua Maternal and Child Health Care Hospital

evidence.tested: Full Frontiers article reports ML screening of asthma transcriptomic biomarkers. Eight genes were selected; external performance varies, so this is a computational biomarker result, not causal biology.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO and SVM-RFE intersected transcriptomic features to select candidate biomarkers.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
